UPDATE scraper_config
        SET lokace  = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), lokace),
            vyraz1  = $3,
            vyraz2  = $4,
            vyraz3  = $5,
            vyraz4  = $6,
            vyraz5  = $7,
            vyraz6  = $8,
            vyraz7  = $9,
            vyraz8  = $10,
            vyraz9  = $11,
            vyraz10 = $12,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1
